description: This PHP class defines a data transfer object (DTO) named EmployeeDistributionBySubunit within the OrangeHRM dashboard module. It encapsulates details about employee distribution data, such as subunit counts, total counts, and limits.

classes.name: EmployeeDistributionBySubunit
classes.description: A data transfer object representing employee distribution data categorized by subunit, including counts and limits.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor initializing the object with subunit count pairs, employee counts, total counts, and a limit.

methods.name: getSubunitCountPairs
methods.description: Returns the array of subunit count pairs.

methods.name: getOtherEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of employees not assigned to a subunit.

methods.name: getUnassignedEmployeeCount
methods.description: Returns the count of unassigned employees.

methods.name: getLimit
methods.description: Returns the limit for subunit counts.

methods.name: getTotalSubunitCount
methods.description: Returns the total number of subunits.
